name: Haunted Gnome
body:
General | Combat Stamina

Haunted Gnome (Combat)
Source Ultimate Combat pg. 104
You use your gnome magic to take on an eerie illusory appearance.

Prerequisites: Cha 13, gnome magic racial trait, Knowledge (arcana) 1 rank.

Benefit: You add haunted fey aspect (page 230) to your list of gnome magic spell-like abilities, and you can use this spell-like ability twice per day.
Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
Source Pathfinder Unchained pg. 122
You can spend 5 stamina points to use haunted fey aspectUC an additional time in a day.
